svg.title: Data Leakage Taxonomy Matrix
svg.text: The Four Major Taxonomies of Data Leakage
Kaufman et al. (2012): The Primary Causes of Catastrophic Production ML Failure
1. Target Leakage (Feature Level)
Features proxying future information or target consequences
Example: 'Hospital_Discharge_Date' when predicting mortality
Example: 'Refund_Processed_Timestamp' when predicting fraud
Signature: Suspiciously perfect ROC-AUC > 0.999
2. Preprocessing Contamination
Fitting transformers on whole dataset before train/test split
Example: scaler.fit(full_df) leaking test mean and variance
Example: TargetEncoder computed globally across all rows
Fix: Strict encapsulation inside sklearn.pipeline.Pipeline
3. Temporal Lookahead Bias
Using future time-stamped records to predict past events
Example: Standard random K-Fold on stock market prices
Example: Rolling averages centered on t instead of lagged
Fix: TimeSeriesSplit with strict chronological purging
4. Group / Identity Contamination
Splitting multiple rows of the same subject across train and test
Example: Multiple X-rays of same patient in train and test
Example: User session clickstreams scattered randomly
Fix: GroupKFold or StratifiedGroupKFold on Entity ID
